instructions.a: We're short on everyday cutlery. Add a stainless-steel set of 12 of the same kind of utensil I use to stir the bowl first, with no other types of cutlery.
instructions.b: Also replace our measuring set with one in the colour of the small tool I use later, so all the tools match. Cups are fine too; keep the first set.
instructions.bundled: Add a stainless-steel set of 12 of the same kind of utensil I use to stir the bowl first, without other types of cutlery. Also add a coordinated measuring set in the colour of the small tool I use later; cups are fine too.
